decisions.reason: As an analytics add-on closely leveraging the firm's existing market-data platform and likely requiring limited standalone investment, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping open while customer adoption continues to clarify.

This electricity tariff calculator is very close to the firm's core calculation and process-support business, so its strategic fit, cross-selling potential and low incremental uncertainty support continued retention.

Because this multi-model energy tariff calculator line is tied to the platform and can still yield learning about which variants customers value, management would likely keep it for another year despite a higher rationalization risk than the other products.

The area definition tool builds directly on the firm's existing data and process capabilities and likely complements other applications, making it a relatively inexpensive option to continue offering while market demand matures.
